watch.summary: A streamer talks about needing to earn Grand Champion rank right before immediately missing an aerial and letting in a goal.

beats.what: Streamer confidently states he has to deserve the rank he wants.
He launches into the air to challenge the ball.
He misses completely and the opponent scores immediately.
He yells out briefly then sits in silent defeat as dramatic music plays.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I'm going to have to deserve to get the rank that I want.
watch.why: The instant comedic timing between his inspirational talk about earning high ranks and his immediate, catastrophic whiff creates a perfect hubris-before-the-fall moment. The sudden transition to dramatic opera music heightens the tragicomedy.
